  WHY: This documentation mismatch would make the phase-5 contract and example expectations fail against the real `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:110` behavior.
- docs/plans/awesome-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase 7, line 791-792 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The test expectation `"Mem.with.dots" becomes "memwithdots"` is wrong because `sanitize_segment("Mem.with.dots", "mem")` does not lowercase or strip internal dots.
  WHY: The asserted prefix segment would not match the actual output, so the specified test would fail.
